name: Mini Projector with 2 Wireless Gamepads
description: An Android smart projector: install your streaming apps and watch on a big screen. It plays games with the two wireless gamepads, and also comes with a remote control and a UK 3-pin power cable. Rated at 65 W. Best used in a dim room.

source.notes: 1688 listing title: Cross-Border Hy320Mini Game Projector Android Hd 4K Retro Game Console F600 Home Projector. One-piece price ¥198 (screenshot shows ≈₦44,081.35; owner said use 222.63). 100+ sold. Store: flagship, 2 years, 38% repurchase (not a return rate; over 30% so noted), service 4.5, comprehensive 93%, store positive 78.6%. Supports custom logo. Item no. Hy320mini game set, colour code 3326, power 65 W, weight 1000 g (packed weight to confirm). In the box from photos: projector, 2 wireless 2.4G gamepads, remote, power cable. Supplier photos show a US two-pin cable; order the British-regulations spec for a UK plug. Not claimed: 4K, resolution, brightness, Android/apps, game count, Wi-Fi (title/box say 4K, Android, WiFi 6, streaming apps; unproven or third-party). Supplier box prints streaming-service logos, so box left out of every photo. Another listing image (HY320 Mini Max, grey face) is a different model: not used. Photos cut from the 1080 px white kit shot and enlarged about 2x, so soft. Likely preloaded unlicensed retro games: IP and customs risk, owner to decide. After the sample: test YouTube, Netflix, Spotify; add the ones that work to the copy in plain text (e.g. 'Tested with YouTube and Spotify'). Never logos. Owner decision 8 Nov: no app names in copy yet, no app logos in photos; copy says only 'install your streaming apps'. Android is from the listing title only: confirm on the sample. Order spec: British regulations (UK plug), ¥198, colour 3326; 1688 domestic freight ¥16 (≈₦3,562 at 222.63, recorded as china_domestic_ngn). Other plugs offered (EU, US, AU) at the same ¥198. Owner 8 Nov: list as is, games wording allowed (no game names, count, brands, 4K or app claims); price ₦150,000 = 70.6% gross margin on ₦44,081 goods, freight and customs not included. Photo 2 (single gamepad) dropped. Sample question skipped.
